title: GeoLibre deployment policy
description: Client-facing settings for a GeoLibre deployment. Every value is public: never put secrets here.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint; ignored by GeoLibre.

version.description: Policy format version. GeoLibre ignores documents with any other version.

capabilities.description: Capabilities granted to users. Omit to grant all; an empty list grants none.

interface.description: UI profile filtering: which data sources, plugins and menus are visible.

enabled.description: Whether UI profile filtering is active (default true).

level.description: Experience-level preset that seeds the hidden lists.

lock.description: Prevent users from changing the profile in Settings.

hiddenDataSources.description: Explicit hidden data-source ids, overriding the preset.

hiddenPlugins.description: Explicit hidden plugin ids, overriding the preset.

hiddenMenus.description: Explicit hidden menu ids, overriding the preset.

hiddenMenuItems.description: Explicit hidden menu item ids, overriding the preset.

plugins.description: Plugin marketplace and loading policy for external plugins.

registryUrl.description: Plugin marketplace registry URL (absolute or relative to the app).

allowed.description: External plugin ids allowed to load. Omit for any; an empty list allows none.

blocked.description: External plugin ids never loaded, even if also allowed.

sideload.description: Allow installing from a manifest URL, zip, directory or project file.

defaultActive.description: Plugin ids active in a fresh project.

services.description: Web-service library offered in the Add Data dialogs.

builtins.description: Set to false to hide the built-in starter services.

fields.description: Form field values for the service kind.

shareUrl.description: Projects server URL, or "off" to remove Share and the Gallery.

embedOrigins.description: Origins allowed to drive a framed app; "*" for any.

ai.description: AI assistant settings. Proxy URLs and tokens stay in server environment, never here.

enabled.description: Expose the same-origin AI assistant route.

appName.description: App name shown in the toolbar and tab title.

welcome.description: Set to false to skip the first-launch welcome wizard.
